save-as-new copies cloud image bytes into the new board and leaves the original asset retained
editor uploads persist, viewer reads are signed, and revoked membership blocks fresh image access
signed image expiry refreshes through the actual authorized API and provider failures support retry
two actual browsers retain simultaneous creates and different-object edits; undo preserves the collaborator's changes
same-object concurrent conflict preserves the offline draft and save-as-new creates a separate recovery board
remote presence carries world coordinates and selections across independent pan and zoom
offline independent edits reconnect through fresh reads and compare-and-swap without overwriting the other browser
a committed operation with a lost response survives reload and replays exactly once
live downgrade and revocation block new writes and fresh reads while retaining the editor's draft
same-device guest tabs synchronize and automatically hand off the latest IndexedDB objects and viewport
same-account tabs edit simultaneously through operations and SSE while different pages keep isolated journals
a stale writer loses mutations and history; its interrupted draft stays under a unique recovery key
